BiblicalUsage: Jochebed is named twice in the Bible, and the passages here are Exodus 6:20; Numbers 26:59. In Exodus 6:20 we read, "And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses..." It appears again in Numbers 26:59: "And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt..."
TheologicalSignificance: Jochebed shows me God does not deal in crowds alone, and this life was known to him by name. That is why I do not skip the lists: every name in them was loved.
